notes: Buttons mode pill gets a drag grip: move it from the handle on its left edge.
Startup crash diagnostics: if the app ever fails to open, it now shows the error on screen instead of just closing.
Settings section (bar or +/- buttons, opacity, haptics, dark/light theme), in-app changelog with what's-new popup. Settings survive updates.
Opacity slider goes to 0%: fully invisible bar that still responds to tap, drag and long-press.
Bar re-docks to the screen edge on rotation instead of floating mid-screen.
Update check tells you plainly: new version available, latest installed, or server unreachable.
Slim edge bar (tap = system slider, drag = move, long-press = hide), self-updates from GitHub, launcher icon, quick-settings tile.
First release: floating volume buttons for broken hardware keys.
